newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE index lifted by late Dow-inspired rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE index lifted by late Dow-inspired rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index finished at the day's best levels on Monday, underpinned by a firm gilts market and boosted in the last half-hour of trade by a sharp turnaround on Wall Street.

The leading index ended 20 points higher at 4,389.7, despite suffering a weaker opening and relatively quiet trade on caution ahead of the UK election on Thursday. Gainers outpaced losers by 51:45. Mid-250 stocks ended lower though, down 4.3 at 4,496.2.
"There is clearly no selling pressure," said one dealer. "We're creeping back to 4,400 again and when we're this close to the election, that is very encouraging."
